title: Benchmark Plan
description: Plan artifact for the provider-benchmark pipeline. Declares the matrix of prompts x providers x variations to execute with controlled parameters.

objective.description: Human-readable description of what this benchmark is measuring (e.g., 'cinematic still quality across paid image providers').

controls.description: Parameters held constant across cells where the provider supports them.

prompts.description: Reusable prompt definitions referenced by cells via prompt_id.

cells.description: One entry per (prompt x provider x variation) intended call.

provider.description: Provider name (e.g. flux, google_imagen, runway, veo).

model.description: Specific model or variant (e.g. flux-pro-1.1, veo-3.1, runway-gen4).

tool.description: Registered tool name from the tool registry that will execute the call.

params.description: Per-cell parameter overrides (seed, resolution, duration, aspect_ratio, etc.).

rationale.description: Why this provider/model was included in the benchmark.
